# End-to-end test: a plugin whose registration is generated by reflect_generate(),
# loaded, inspected, unloaded and reloaded by a host. Needs RTTR (shared), flecs
# sources, Qt 5 and the PropertyEditor checkout:
#   cmake -S . -B build-rg -G Ninja -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<rttr install> \
#         -DFLECS_ROOT=<flecs checkout> -DRPE_ROOT=<PropertyEditor>
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(reflectgen_test C CXX)
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17) # RTTR 0.9.6 headers vs libstdc++ in C++20 mode don't mix
endif()
# One output dir so the host finds every DLL next to it on Windows.
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)

add_subdirectory(.. reflectgen)

find_package(rttr CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(FLECS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "flecs checkout (built as a DLL through its own CMake)")
set(RPE_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "PropertyEditor checkout")

set(FLECS_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLECS_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${FLECS_ROOT} flecs)

# The real rpe_core (needs Qt). EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL: only what the test links is built.
# It picks up the RTTR::Core / flecs::flecs targets defined above.
set(RPE_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${RPE_ROOT} rpe EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# The same plugin built twice: v2 (GAME_PLUGIN_V2) changes Light, so the host can
# hot-reload v1 → v2 → v1 and check the component data survives.
function(add_game_plugin name)
    add_library(${name} MODULE plugin/plugin.cpp plugin/game/Components.h plugin/game/More.h
        plugin/game/NeedsPrelude.h plugin/game/Advanced.h)
    target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE plugin)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE reflect::runtime rpe::core flecs::flecs)
    set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -fno-gnu-unique) # let dlclose really unload
    endif()
    # NeedsPrelude.h only parses with the target's forced include, its PCH header
    # and a language-conditioned define; reflectgen must see all three.
    # -fno-gnu-unique (GCC only) is an option clang rejects, which reflectgen drops.
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE /FI${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/plugin/prelude.h)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/plugin/prelude.h)
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:GAME_CXX_ONLY> ${ARGN})
    target_precompile_headers(${name} PRIVATE <vector>)
    # Several generated files in one translation unit must not collide.
    set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES UNITY_BUILD ON)
    reflect_generate(${name})
endfunction()
add_game_plugin(game_plugin)
add_game_plugin(game_plugin_v2 GAME_PLUGIN_V2)

add_executable(host host_main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(host PRIVATE reflect::runtime rpe::core flecs::flecs RTTR::Core ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME plugin_roundtrip COMMAND host $<TARGET_FILE:game_plugin> $<TARGET_FILE:game_plugin_v2>)

# SCAN BUILD + batching: a module whose header gains REFLECT only after configure.
set(SCAN_LATER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/scan/Later.h)
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${SCAN_LATER} CONTENT
    "#pragma once\n// starts without the macro; scan_build_test.cmake adds it\nnamespace scanprobe { struct Later { int b = 0; }; }\n")
add_library(scan_probe MODULE scan/probe.cpp scan/Always.h ${SCAN_LATER})
target_link_libraries(scan_probe PRIVATE reflect::runtime rpe::core flecs::flecs)
set_target_properties(scan_probe PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
reflect_generate(scan_probe SCAN BUILD BATCH_SIZE 2)
_reflect_out_name(${SCAN_LATER} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/reflect_gen/scan_probe SCAN_LATER_GEN _rel)
add_test(NAME scan_build_picks_up_new_header
         COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DBUILD_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} -DHEADER=${SCAN_LATER} -DGEN=${SCAN_LATER_GEN}
                 -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scan/scan_build_test.cmake)

# game_plugin has forced includes (prelude.h, PCH <vector>): its parse PCH must exist.
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/check_pch.cmake [=[
file(SIZE ${PCH} size)
if(size EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "parse PCH is empty: ${PCH}")
endif()
message(STATUS "PASS: parse PCH ${size} bytes")
]=])
add_test(NAME parse_pch_built
         COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DPCH=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/reflect_gen/game_plugin/reflectgen_parse_$<CONFIG>.pch
                 -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/check_pch.cmake)

# Misuse is a build error with a message that says what to fix.
add_test(NAME generator_diagnostics
         COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DREFLECTGEN=$<TARGET_FILE:reflectgen>
                 -DHEADER=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/diag/Bad.h -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bad.gen.cpp
                 "-DARGS=$<IF:$<BOOL:${MSVC}>,--driver-mode=cl;/I,-I>${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include"
                 -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/diag/expect.cmake)
